pages.text: $(thing)/upipes stats$() lists endpoints and cost per tick per dimension.$(br)$(thing)/upipes profile [n]$() lists the slowest faces.$(br)$(thing)/upipes rebuild$() forces network rediscovery.

Limits, tick budget, bridging, styling and tier rules are in the mod configuration screen. Per-tier values and the tier feature table are datapack files under $(thing)universal_pipes/universal_pipes$().
